title: Asset budgets for the glb validator (tools/art/asset_budgets.json)
$comment: 07 s4.7 / s5.1 / s1.2 (ART-05): per-class and per-asset triangle ceilings, file-size ceilings, scale-chart sizes and required hardpoints / parts read by tools/art/validate_glb.py and by pw.finalize(). Tools data, not a content def: never enters the content hash.

size_tolerance_frac.$comment: V08: each checked axis within +- this fraction of the chart size (default 0.10)

size_tolerance_min_m.$comment: V08: absolute slack for thin assets such as the 0.8 m Pad slab (default 0.25)

max_tris.$comment: ceiling when an asset has no entry of its own

parts.$comment: V15: node names every asset of the class must have (Foundation on structures)

size_m.$comment: [X, Y, Z] extent in Blender axes (Z up, ships nose +Y): ships [span, length, height], structures [footprint x, footprint y, height above ground]; null = not charted (V08 skips that axis)

hardpoints.$comment: V11: required beyond the ship minimum (HP_Nose, HP_Tail, HP_Gear_0..2)

parts.$comment: V15: required node names (Turret, Barrel, Roof, Arm_L/R)

far.$comment: V15: a mesh node named <PascalId>Far (e.g. ShipDartFar, the presentation far_mesh_node) is required (07 s4.2: every unit and every structure over 15 m)
